conventions.energy_variable: kinetic_energy_per_nucleon in GeV/n: the ratio of the bin-integrated fluxes (r3 P2; equal to the ratio of their bin averages), isotopes summed at equal E/n (P3)
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest)
conventions.mass_approximation: bare-nucleus masses of AME2020 (core.constants.physical) for the rigidity mapping; USINE's own kinematics inside the run

normalization.convention: ratio of two bin-integrated fluxes; the normalization cancels

phase_space.definition: USINE local interstellar flux at the observer (r = 8.3 kpc, z = 0), before solar modulation

observable.process: unmodulated local interstellar B/C from a USINE V3.5 run (Model2DKisoVc): ratio of bin integrals of 10B+11B over 12C (13C, 14C not in the network)

conventions.energy_variable: kinetic_energy_per_nucleon in GeV/n: the ratio of the bin-integrated fluxes (r3 P2; equal to the ratio of their bin averages), isotopes summed at equal E/n (P3)
conventions.frame: Galactic rest frame (interstellar gas at rest)

observable.process: unmodulated local interstellar 10Be/9Be from a USINE V3.5 run (Model2DKisoVc): ratio of bin integrals of 10Be over 9Be

coordinates: unit cube of the feature boxes (log axis for scale log)

domain_model.method: whitened Mahalanobis + k-NN (cKDTree) + subspace residual, thresholds calibrated on held-out training points

context.simulator: USINE V3.5 through the cr-provider/1 provider usine

sources.spatial: not fixed by harmonized-v1; each code records its choice
sources.abundances: fixed by the parent list of theory:cr-secondary-ratio

cross_sections.ghost_threshold: off: ghost nuclei and tertiary chains off on both sides

self_check.note: a reader recomputes these and refuses the model if they differ by more than 1e-9
